method_summary: This selector unifies all rounds with a single minimum-cost bipartite matching strategy on the top-k*15 quality candidates (quality = uncertainty × exp(-nearest_pivot_dist/sigma)), with cost = 2·distance − average_quality·sigma to balance diversity and informativeness. Removing the early/late round split simplifies the logic and applies matching-based diversity throughout training, while increasing pivots to k*4 improves quality estimate robustness.
